name: Avenging the Fallen
summary: At Revantusk Village, Markhor turns his anger toward the Skylords. He asks you to slay a Razorbeak Skylord and bring him its plume.

sections.title: Slaying the Skylords
sections.body:
Huntsman Markhor of Revantusk Village resents the Wildhammer for training gryphons to slay trolls. He promises justice for the trolls, but first he wants you to strike at the Skylords, the Hinterlands' elder gryphons.

Slay a Razorbeak Skylord and bring its plume back to Markhor. This rare breed lives in the wilds of the Hinterlands. Markhor blames it for breeding murderous young.

sections.title: The Plume Examined
sections.body: Markhor studies the plume and wonders how many hunters the beast devoured before your hand brought it justice.

faq.answer: Huntsman Markhor offers the hunt at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why does Huntsman Markhor want a Skylord slain?
faq.answer: Markhor says the Wildhammer train gryphons to slay trolls. He wants the region's elder gryphons, the Skylords, eradicated, and blames the rare Razorbeak Skylord for breeding murderous young.

faq.q: Where can a Razorbeak Skylord be found?
faq.answer: Markhor says the rare Razorbeak Skylord keeps to the wilds of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What must be brought back to Markhor?
faq.answer: The plume of a Razorbeak Skylord, which means slaying one first.
